Six facultative treatment ponds (Ponds 1 to 6) with surface aerators, followed by two polishing ponds (Ponds 7 and 8) function to remove Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD ) and Total Suspended Solids (TSS) from the influent wastewater.
Treated effluent is discharged to one of three 7-acre infiltration basins (Basin A, Basin B, and Basin C).
Treated effluent may be discharged into a temporary infiltration basin (Basin D).
Treated effluent may also be disposed from Basin A to the temporary emergency controlled flood field 1 which is directly east of the current WWTP and field 2 which is to the east of basin D.
Gonzales will periodically hire a third party to dredge and dispose of accumulated sludge and debris in the treatment ponds.
